Title: New deployment strategies and caching for Azure Pipelines

Body.Content:
We are making improvements to Azure Pipelines, a continuous integration and continuous delivery platform built into Azure, including some much-requested features. Customers can leverage new deployment strategies for their Continuous Delivery pipelines, including canary for Kubernetes, and rolling for VMs as well as Kubernetes. Additionally, we are announcing the General Availability of caching inside Azure Pipelines, so customers can speed up the execution of their pipelines by caching intermediate build artifacts.
